title: VOICE TYPING: MICROPHONE PERMISSION
summary: Having trouble with Voice Typing or mic not responding? Please ensure Orbit Board has been granted Microphone permission in your device's App Info.
highlights: 🎙️ How to Grant: Long-press Orbit Board app icon -> App info -> Permissions -> Microphone -> Choose 'Allow'
⚙️ Alternative: Phone Settings -> Apps -> Orbit Board -> Permissions -> Enable Microphone
🔇 Click Sound Mute: Orbit Board Settings -> Typing -> Mute Voice Typing Sound
🔒 100% Offline: Voice recognition runs strictly on-device with zero network transmissions
